requirements.requirement: The system must validate that NPI credential data containing board certifications is correctly parsed into a structured certification list.
The system must verify that each extracted certification includes expected fields defined in the schema (e.g., name, issuing body if available).
The system must confirm that relevance scoring returns a non-null numeric score for providers with at least one certification.
The system must verify that certifications matching the queried specialty produce a higher relevance score than unrelated certifications.
The system must validate that keyword or taxonomy alignment logic produces deterministic and repeatable scores for the same input data.
The system must confirm that the board certification measure is included in the Evaluate Care facade API response payload.
The system must validate that the API response structure for board certification matches the schema defined in EVAL-BOARD-ST-001.
The system must return an empty certification list and a zero or null relevance score when no certifications are present in NPI data.
The system must assign a low or zero relevance score when certifications are present but unrelated to the queried specialty.
The system must handle malformed or incomplete NPI credential data without throwing unhandled exceptions and still return a valid API response.
The system must ensure integration tests validate end-to-end flow from NPI data input through scoring logic to API output.
The system must verify that multiple certifications are aggregated correctly and do not overwrite each other in the output.
The system must confirm that scoring logic behaves consistently when multiple relevant certifications are present (e.g., does not decrease score incorrectly).
The system must validate that unit tests follow existing backend test patterns and structure in the backend/tests directory.
